namespace Contribution

def AdmitsWitness (verify : Nat → Nat → Bool) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ w : Nat, verify x w = true

def UniformNormalization (verify : Nat → Nat → Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ x w : Nat, verify x w = true → verify x 0 = true

def normalizedVerifier (verify : Nat → Nat → Bool) (x : Nat) : Bool :=
  verify x 0

theorem witness_normalization (verify : Nat → Nat → Bool)
    (normalization : UniformNormalization verify) :
    ∀ x : Nat, AdmitsWitness verify x ↔ normalizedVerifier verify x = true := by
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro accepted
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := accepted
    exact normalization x w hw
  · intro accepted
    exact ⟨0, accepted⟩

end Contribution
